messages:
Emily Park: Quick sync — AcmeCloud wants minute-level usage reporting for their HW marketplace SKU. Cutover planned Tue 08:00 UTC. I want a short playbook: what must be green before we flip the flag?
Omar Ruiz: I can own the ingestion side. Top priorities: idempotency keys, timestamp normalization (they send local tz), and signature verification. Need a smoke harness.
Liam Chen: Agree. Also: sampling vs full stream — if traffic spikes we should auto-backoff to hourly rollups. Need a circuit-breaker policy.
Sophie Patel: From partner ops: they can send minutely or batched every 5m. They prefer near-real time. We'll confirm payload schema today.
Omar Ruiz: Checklist proposal: 1) schema contract signed 2) signature handshake tested 3) timezone normalization verified 4) dedupe window understood 5) backfill plan 6) dashboard + alerts
Emily Park: Can you sketch the alert thresholds? e.g., 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m or ingestion lag > 120s?
Liam Chen: Yeah — draft: 5xx >= 0.5% sustained 5m -> rollback; avg ingestion lag > 120s for 5m -> throttle partner + paged oncall; duplicate rate > 1% -> investigate.
Sophie Patel: Partner will run a QA stream tomorrow 02:00 UTC. They will replay 48h of synthetic customers. Can we run that against staging?
Omar Ruiz: staging ready. I'll wire up a relay that rewrites timestamps into UTC for testing.
metering-bot: smoke test report: 2025-11-04T02:00Z - 1200 events ingested, 0 signature failures, 3 duplicates (0.25%).
Emily Park: Nice. Next: reconciliation expectations. Partner wants same-day billing alignment but we should offer a 24h reconciliation window for late arrivals. Any objections?
Liam Chen: 24h window ok. We should emit an "arrival_latency" metric per event to drive SLA reports.
Sophie Patel: On entitlements — they have seat-based and device-based SKUs. Need mapping doc: partner_sku -> redwood_sku + billing_unit (min vs seat). I'll send mapping by EOD.
Omar Ruiz: For backfill: provide an idempotent replay endpoint. We'll accept replay with "replay_id" header and ignore duplicates if seen. Share the header format: `X-Acme-Replay-Id`.
Emily Park: Runbook for cutover (draft): 1) confirm partner QA smoke green on staging 2) deploy small canary to prod (1% traffic) 3) monitor errors/lag/dup for 15m 4) increase to 10% for 15m 5) full flip 6) 1h post-cutover retrospective
Liam Chen: Add automatic fallback: if any alert fires during canary, revert traffic to hourly rollup and open incident channel #incidents.
Sophie Patel: Who will own the canary bump? Partner or Redwood?
Omar Ruiz: Redwood infra will flip routing; partner toggles payload frequency. Need a single phone / Zoom for the window.
Emily Park: I'll own coordination and postmortem. Omar will run the relay and rollback logic. Liam will own monitoring + metrics. Sophie will coordinate partner ops.
deploy-bot: prod-canary deployment queued by Omar — id 20251104-canary-1799 — starting in 10m
metering-bot: prod smoke after canary start: 2025-11-04T08:12Z - 350 events/min, 0.02% 5xx, avg lag 18s
Emily Park: Perfect. After cutover we should schedule a reconciliation run comparing partner ledger vs our ingested events (script: tools/partner_recon.sh) and capture any deltas. Anyone want to add tests to that script?
Liam Chen: I'll add tolerance checks and anomaly alerts.
Sophie Patel: Partner will provide a weekly CSV of entitlements for cross-checking. We'll reconcile daily for first week.
Emily Park: Great — I'll circulate this thread as the playbook and set the calendar invite. If anything changes ping me ASAP. :thumbsup:
Omar Ruiz: Thanks — I'll post the staging webhook sample here so partner can test quickly:
Omar Ruiz: ```
{
  "device_id": "acme-12345",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-04T02:00:00-08:00",
  "usage_min": 1,
  "sku": "ACME-HW-VM1",
  "signature": "sha256=...",
  "replay_id": "r-20251104-01"
}
```
Emily Park: Awesome. Last ask: please include a short list of rollback signals in the calendar invite. I'll close the loop once partner confirms the mapping.
metering-bot: reconciliation job scheduled: daily @ 09:00 UTC for first 7 days post-cutover
